resources.string: Press and hold a description for more information.
This permission is needed for the app to display a notification when a mobile network is detected. Disabling this permission has no other effect.
Show a notification when a mobile network is found. \n\nNotifications must be enabled in the app\'s permissions. If the status shows "Denied", long press on the toggle to access the app\'s settings.
Denied (long press on toggle to change)
